page_title: INT 4-1 CRE | Inter v Cremonese 04/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' A cross from Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Cremonese failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
87' 4 - 1 Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and with a precise low drive puts the ball into the middle of the goal.
86' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Ermano Feliciani ignores the protests.
84' Ermano Feliciani shows the yellow card to Petar Sucic (Inter) for a heavy challenge.
83' Davide Frattesi (Inter) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Marco Silvestri easily deals with the threat.
81' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 7:7.
77' The resulting set piece from Inter is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
76' Davide Frattesi (Inter) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
75' Substitution. Petar Sucic (Inter) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Lautaro Martinez walks off.
75' Cristian Chivu prepares a substitution. Henrikh Mkhitaryan is replaced by Andy Diouf (Inter).
74' Substitution. Romano Floriani makes way for Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese).
72' Inter can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
72' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Inter.
71' 10:0 – the corner kicks stats.
71' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marco Silvestri intercepts the ball.
67' The photographers scatter as a shot from the edge of the box by Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) blazes well wide of the right post.
63' Manuel Akanji (Inter) rises high to meet a cross from the corner kick and plants a header from inside the penalty area. His effort went just narrowly wide of the left post.
63' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Inter.
63' Inter take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
62' Carlos Augusto (Inter) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
61' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Alessandro Bastoni as he is replaced by Carlos Augusto (Inter).
60' The substitution has been made. Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) has replaced Ange-Yoan Bonny.
58' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mikayil Faye (Cremonese) replacing Federico Ceccherini.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) comes onto the pitch for Franco Vazquez.
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Antonio Sanabria departs the field of play to be replaced by Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese).

57' 4 - 0 Goal! Ange-Yoan Bonny plays in Nicolo Barella (Inter), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box he shoots into the left side of the net! Great finish - 4:0.
55' 3 - 0 Federico Dimarco (Inter) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box. The ball goes into the bottom right corner and past the goalkeeper.
54' The ball goes out for a corner. Inter can continue in their attacking effort.
54' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Alessandro Bastoni (Inter), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
54' Cristian Chivu has decided to make a change. Luis Henrique (Inter) replaces Denzel Dumfries.
51' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 16:1.
49' The corner is swung in but Inter can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
48' Federico Dimarco (Inter) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
46' Davide Nicola has made a change at the break. Jari Vandeputte has come on in place of Dennis Johnsen (Cremonese).
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Inter comes to nothing.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
43' Federico Dimarco (Inter) hits a piledriver from the edge of the box, but Marco Silvestri acrobatically dives to stop the effort. Superb save!

38' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) makes it 2:0. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Federico Dimarco and planted his close-range header into the left side of the goal. Marco Silvestri was helpless.
37' The rebound finds Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance!
37' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
32' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
29' Foul! Warren Bondo (Cremonese) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
27' A corner kick by Inter is thwarted by the well prepared Marco Silvestri (Cremonese).
27' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
25' Nicolo Barella (Inter) tackles a bit over-zealously and Ermano Feliciani blows for a foul.
24' Total attempts – 11:0.
21' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety.
19' Federico Dimarco (Inter) blows a clear opportunity! He needed only to tap the ball in, but narrowly misses the goal.
19' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Marco Silvestri sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the left post.
18' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot goalwards, but the keeper produces a decent save!
17' None of the Inter players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
17' Davide Frattesi (Inter) hits a shot towards the right side of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Marco Silvestri.
14' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Inter due to an offside in the build-up play.
13' The Inter players halt their celebrations as referee Ermano Feliciani makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
12' Goal! Federico Dimarco unleashes a strike and Manuel Akanji (Inter) deflects the shot into the net with his body. 2:0.
12' It will be a corner kick for Inter.
11' Inter have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
8' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) is penalised for holding. Ermano Feliciani signals a set piece.
6' 1 - 0 Lautaro Martinez (Inter) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
1' Davide Frattesi (Inter) takes a nice first touch to control a cross and fires in from the penalty spot, but his effort zooms just past the right post.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Cremonese will take the kick-off.
Ermano Feliciani got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
